items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Things like Alberta, let your hair hang old? [INTERVIEWEE] I remember that...

ctx.x: I can't exactly recall now, but it was back in the Longin steamboat times, when the excursions was coming up the river, you know, down by the big excursion boats then.
Oh, I see. Did you ever hear any of the songs the Roustabout sang on the river, loading and unloading? Things like Alberta, let your hair hang old?

I remember that, but who knows who can I. Well, of course, we practiced that. We were all upstairs at all times. And so they're taking us into New Orleans. And we got into the St. Charles Hotel. And they had a heavy orchestra there. And they had us dressed like the old farmers with the big hats and the overalls. And so we went in there. And now, the first had taken us out to the riverfront. We got in there just a little before the big boats got in. And all the big heavy orchestra was cutting up out there in the…
